warnings.headline: Gale, yellow level, Froeya - Roervik, 2026-11-14T09:00:00+00:00, 2026-11-15T13:00:00+00:00
warnings.description: From late Saturday morning south near gale force 7, Saturday afternoon becoming southwest gale force 8, occasionally severe gale force 9, first in south. From Sunday afternoon near gale force 7.
warnings.instruction: Do not go out in a small boat: High risk of dangerous situations when in a small boat at sea. Do not go out in a small boat: High risk of dangerous situations when in a small boat at sea. If the engine stops you can float towards land.
